Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.dbmanager.jdbc

Class QueryResult

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.dbmanager.jdbc.QueryResult
public final class QueryResult extends Object
The outcome of executing one SQL statement: either a row set, an update count, or an error. Values are copied out of the JDBC result set so the connection's cursor can be closed immediately and the grid can page over the rows in memory.

Instances are immutable and created through the of... factories.

    • ofResultSet

      public static QueryResult ofResultSet(String sql, List<ColumnMeta> columns, List<List<Object>> rows, boolean truncated, long elapsedMillis)
      Builds a result-set outcome.
      Parameters:
      sql - the executed statement
      columns - column metadata
      rows - the fetched rows (already capped)
      truncated - true when the row limit cut the result short
      elapsedMillis - execution time
      Returns:
      the result

    • ofUpdate

      public static QueryResult ofUpdate(String sql, int updateCount, long elapsedMillis)
      Builds a DML/DDL update-count outcome.
      Parameters:
      sql - the executed statement
      updateCount - rows affected (may be 0 or a driver's SUCCESS_NO_INFO)
      elapsedMillis - execution time
      Returns:
      the result

    • ofError

      public static QueryResult ofError(String sql, String errorMessage, long elapsedMillis)
      Builds a failure outcome.
      Parameters:
      sql - the statement that failed
      errorMessage - the driver's message
      elapsedMillis - time spent before the failure
      Returns:
      the result
